title: HUJI Pitch-Feedback LLM Judge Output
description: Structured output for the Phase 229 calibrated judge (sonnet judging opus). Scores ONLY the corpus-stable Real/Win/Worth spine (1-5 per dimension) plus D1/D6/D7 violation lists. The judge NEVER emits the raw letter/percentage/point grade - those three incompatible corpus scales are normalized into this one spine before anything is compared.

submission_id.description: The anchor or submission id being judged (for example 04-circular-manufacturing).

real.description: Is-it-Real: is the problem real, evidenced, and grounded in what the pitch actually said. 1-5, normalized per the map in judge-prompt.md (< 50 pct = 1, 50-64 = 2, 65-79 = 3, 80-89 = 4, 90+ = 5).

win.description: Can-we-Win: is the proposed approach differentiated and defensible. 1-5, same normalization.

worth.description: Is-it-Worth-it: is the opportunity worth pursuing at course scale. 1-5, same normalization.

d1_violations.description: D1 grounding violations: each ungrounded or fabricated claim, and each covered element wrongly marked missing. Empty array = clean.

d6_violations.description: D6 tone violations: grade-and-compliment theater, double-punished metacognition (a self-named gap penalized instead of credited), or disfluency/non-native language penalized as content. Empty array = clean.

d7_violations.description: D7 course-tier feed-forward violations: an investor-gauntlet demand, a next step above course level, or a summary that scores without a concrete next-step path. Empty array = clean.
